title: Blot excess water from wet hair
instruction: Use the microfiber towel to blot excess water from the hair on the salon training head. Leave the hair intact and let go when finished.
setup: Development draft: full-size clamped salon training head with twelve wet flexible locks. A separate 180 × 240 mm microfiber towel starts held open by the two corners of its 180 mm edge, with the 240 mm length hanging down, 170 mm behind the head centre and 305 mm above the table. The towel initially clears the hair; both demo and Dream use this same pre-held setup.
fidelity: Flexible native hair and towel; contact-gated capillary transfer conserves water. Material parameters are approximate.
scores: No validated demo or Dream run.
